breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the polar second moment of area (J) is incorrect for this calculation. The generated specification explicitly uses the correct second moment of area (I) in the formula κ = M/(EI) and even adds a clarifying statement: 'The polar second moment J is not used; use I as specified.' This aligns with the ground truth, which removes the incorrect instruction.
